repairs.quote: Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location. Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for 3 minutes that creates a zone that Slows by 35% when stepped on by an enemy. After 2 seconds, the trap detonates, dealing (20/80/140/200/260 + (120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. This ability has 2 charges (24/21.5/19/16.5/14 second refresh). Lotus Trap hits deal 65% damage to minions, and enemies recently hit by another Lotus Trap.
